taxonomySources.title: Agentic Video Understanding: A Survey (requested v1)
taxonomySources.note: Sections II-A, VI and VII distinguish task/capability, supervision, evidence-access regime and evaluation format. Table III explicitly defines Video Mode as access to evidence, not camera viewpoint. The local task families and viewpoint facet are our navigation synthesis, not a copied method taxonomy. Dataset use does not establish which agent architecture is required.

classificationNotes: Resources preserve the existing 107-entry inventory. Grouped families and editions remain grouped rather than being silently split or double-counted.
Tasks identify capabilities evaluated or supervised. Memory QA does not necessarily evaluate memory construction or maintenance independently.
Video types describe source observations. Access protocols describe what evidence a system may use. Neither implies real-time throughput, bounded storage, physical deployment or public availability.
Evaluation formats describe outputs, not a shared metric or directly comparable performance. Training-only resources have no evaluation format.
Classification relies on the wiki notes and archived evidence register. Not specified marks missing evidence rather than inferred protocol.
A resource may appear in multiple task/view/format groups, but retains one stable identity and introducing publication.
Resources with a substantive robot-learning, robot-memory or robot-safety purpose are routed to Robotics. M3-Bench-robot is actor-recorded general memory QA and remains outside that route.
